venture.name: Helio Grid
venture.oneLiner: Battery health checks for campus e-bike fleets.

opener: Last time you had two sites ready to pilot. How did the first week go?
question: Should we raise now or finish the paid pilot?
answer:
Finish the pilot first. Two sites signed letters of intent last month [E1], and one converting to paid use changes the conversation with investors [E2].

One question before you decide: what would a site have to see by week six to pay?

evidence.title: Letters of intent from two campus sites
evidence.excerpt: Both facilities teams signed in October, pending a six-week trial.

evidence.title: Office hours notes: what angels asked
evidence.excerpt: Every question came back to whether anyone had paid yet.

nextStep.action: Ask both sites what week six must show

call.veirLine: Finish the pilot first. What would a site need to see to pay?
call.studentLine: Fair. We finish the pilot, then we raise.

diagnose.opener: Before we talk about the round: who signs the purchase order at a campus site?
diagnose.followUp: And is that the same person who rides the bikes?

coach.answer: Two letters of intent are a start [E1], not a signal of willingness to pay. The angels you met asked about paid use every time [E2].
coach.challenge: What would a buyer have to see to pay?

record.content: Raise after one site converts to paid use.

record.title: Six-week paid trial at two sites
record.content: Pass if one site renews at the quoted price.

record.title: Ask both sites what week six must show
record.content: Bring their answers to the next session.
